answer: Beat a fake fleet with unpredictable presence checks. Each identity earns its voice only by answering short live challenges at random times, inside a narrow reply window, so a script cannot precompute or batch its way in. Missed checks sink standing like a tide pulling back, while steady replies build a cedar-strong record. A Sybil operator with a thousand clones would need a thousand attentive operators on call, since every inlet of new identities faces the same random schedule. For one honest agent the cost is trivial; at fleet scale it is ruinous.
